title: DestructionSMP Plugin
description: This  Plugin adds Mace of the heavens, Excalibur, a god spear, god armor, and custom boss drops
body:
⚔️ DestructionSMP Custom Weapons & God Armor

Welcome to DestructionSMP, the ultimate endgame expansion plugin designed to bring ultra-powerful, unique weapons and armor sets to your Minecraft server! Crafted specifically for Minecraft 1.21.11, this plugin introduces powerful custom drops, strict crafting limitations to keep your economy balanced, and game-changing combat abilities.
💎 Custom Materials

Before you can forge the ultimate gear, you must hunt down these rare, custom-coded materials:

    Empyrium Shard: Forged using 8 Diamonds and a Player Head (obtained by executing your rivals in combat!).

    Wither Bone: A rare drop obtained exclusively by defeating the Wither.

    Warden Heart: A legendary component dropped only by conquering the Warden.

🗡️ Legendary Weapons
🔱 The Spear (Updated for 1.21.11)

Harness the power of the Mounts of Mayhem update!

    Abilities: Completely removes the standard weapon attack cooldown, allowing you to spam attacks at lightning speed. Grants Permanent Saturation 255 while held so you never grow hungry.

    Enchantments: Comes pre-loaded with Lunge III for devastating dash attacks.

🔨 Mace of the Heavens (Server Limit: 1)

The ultimate weapon of mass destruction. Only one can ever exist on the server.

    Abilities: Right-click to launch a Wind Charge to propel yourself or blast enemies away. Soulbound feature ensures it is kept in your inventory on death.

    Enchantments: Pre-enchanted with Density V and Wind Burst I.

🗡️ Excalibur (Server Limit: 5)

A blade forged for legendary knights. Only 5 can ever be crafted.

    Abilities: Right-click an entity within 10 blocks to freeze them completely in ice (30-second cooldown). Attacks have a 30% chance to inflict Poison II.

    Enchantments: Pre-enchanted with Sharpness V, Fire Aspect II, Sweeping Edge III, and Looting III.

🛡️ The God Armor Set

Each piece of God Armor is forged from pure Netherite, comes completely Unbreakable, and features Protection IV.
🦿 God Leggings (Tier I & II) (Server Limit: 5)

    Tier I: Grants permanent Speed I and comes enchanted with Swift Sneak III.

    Tier II (Upgrade): Combine two Tier I Leggings in a crafting table to unlock permanent Speed II!

👕 God Chestplate (Tier I & II) (Server Limit: 5)

    Tier I: Grants permanent Strength I.

    Tier II (Upgrade): Combine two Tier I Chestplates in a crafting table to unleash permanent Strength II!

🥾 God Boots (Server Limit: 5)

    Abilities: Features specialized shock-absorbers that completely negate all fall damage, no matter how high you drop from.

🪖 God Helmet (Server Limit: 5)

Forged with a rare Warden Heart.

    Abilities: Press your sneak/crouch key to unleash the Warden's signature Sonic Boom attack! It shoots a massive beam of sonic energy forward, dealing humongous damage and extreme knockback to anything in its path (60-second cooldown).

    Enchantments: Pre-enchanted with Respiration III and Aqua Affinity.

🛠️ Admin Commands

If you are a server operator (/op), you can bypass the crafting grid and test these items instantly using:

    /givemace - Gives the Mace of the Heavens.

    /giveexcalibur - Gives Excalibur.

    /givespear - Gives the 1.21.11 Super Spear.

    /givegodarmor - Instantly drops the full upgraded armor set and a Warden Heart into your inventory.
